statement: In the noise-dominated (small-batch) regime, SGDM's mean-square stability condition reduces to rho(I - eta_eff K + eta_eff^2 G) < 1 with eta_eff = eta/(1-beta) (Theorem 4.1).

verification_regime.note: small-eta asymptotic regime where the reduction is exact

mutation_test: With beta=0 (plain SGD) the update/-eta_eff-g ratio is 0.10, not 1 -- momentum (the v buffer) is what produces the eta_eff = eta/(1-beta) rescaling, so the factor is load-bearing.
